subject.title: I updated Scrapling and the skill became hidden again

question: After approved-version caching reached production, is Scrapling still hidden because live data needs restoration, another automated path remains uncovered, or an intentional policy hold applies?
rationale: The public outage is confirmed, but private scan provenance, moderation state, audit history, manual overrides, account state, and deployment data determine which action is safe.

options.title: Audit and restore production state
options.body: Inspect the live skill, versions, approved-version cache, moderation records, and audit log, then restore or backfill the last approved listing if no intentional hold applies.

options.title: Retain intentional hold
options.body: Keep the listing hidden if a documented security or content-policy decision applies and communicate the durable reason to the publisher.

options.title: Patch the remaining visibility path
options.body: If production data shows another automated update route bypasses approved-version preservation, fix that path and add focused regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Audit and restore production state
recommendation.body: Inspect the live skill, versions, approved-version cache, moderation records, and audit log, then restore or backfill the last approved listing if no intentional hold applies.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current backend moderation path and previously resolved this listing's related incident.
